generic_cruise_port.evidence: Grade C sourced composite (Grade B per-line prevalences; Grade C implicated-share carry and null-line zero floor) — consensus tranche 55
generic_cruise_port.notes: Generic high-income cruise embarkation-port provisioning source — the shipped default covariate. q_source = (1/7) x sum over COMMON_SOURCE_LOT_ITEM_LINES of per-line dispatch/retail norovirus RNA prevalence x the implicated-titre share f = 0.141 (Lowther 2018, DOI 10.1007/s12560-018-9338-4, R: 9.7% of POS oysters >100 copies/g of 68.7% positive). Per-line bands: shellfish [0.039, 0.144] (Woods & Burkhardt 2010 Sec; EFSA 2019 DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2019.5762 dispatch batches 10.8% CI 8.2-14.4, R); salad_leaf [0, 0.053] (Terio 2017 DOI 10.1016/j.ijfoodmicro.2017.03.008 0/911, Ab; Cook 2019 DOI 10.1016/j.fm.2018.12.003 lettuce 5.3%, Ab); fresh_produce [0.0036, 0.036] (Steele 2022 DOI 10.1016/j.ijfoodmicro.2022.109840 0.36%, Ab; Cook 2019 frozen raspberry 3.6%, Ab; Miotti 2024 DOI 10.1016/j.ijfoodmicro.2024.110577 pooled 2.12%, Ab, inside); deli/bakery/dairy/garnish null for this stratum, carried at 0. RNA-detection rung [0.0061, 0.033] is recorded in the tranche, not shipped: under titre_draw_mode two_mode every minted lot draws the implicated band, so the shipped q is implicated-scale. Not fitted to any scored anchor; supersedes the declared U(2e-4, 5e-4) (PROVISIONED-SOURCE-01 contract §1.3). Construction, strata and nulls: docs/literature/consensus_tranche_55_provisioned_lot_prevalence.md.
